symbols.meaning: Conditional probability density function of X given Y = y
Conditional probability density function of Y given X = x
Marginal probability density function of X evaluated at x
Marginal probability density function of Y evaluated at y
Joint probability density function of X and Y

steps.text: Express the conditional density of X given Y = y using the definition of conditional density: f_{X|Y=y}(x) = \frac{f_{X,Y}(x,y)}{f_Y(y)}.
Express the conditional density of Y given X = x using the definition of conditional density: f_{Y|X=x}(y) = \frac{f_{X,Y}(x,y)}{f_X(x)}.

Express the joint density as f_{X,Y}(x,y) = f_{Y|X=x}(y) f_X(x) and substitute it into the conditional density expression for X given Y = y to obtain Bayes' theorem: f_{X|Y=y}(x) = \frac{f_{Y|X=x}(y) f_X(x)}{f_Y(y)}.

assumptions.assumption: The values x and y are within the support of X and Y, ensuring f_X(x) > 0 and f_Y(y) > 0.

failure_modes.signature: Undefined or infinite conditional density value.
failure_modes.cause: The marginal density f_Y(y) is zero.
